name: Transaction price materially different from market value
description: Price paid differs sharply from market value, comparable sales or estimates without commercial justification.
fp: Distressed sales, rare items, quality differences or volatile markets.

links.name: Contract price well above market or estimate
links.ctx: Awarded price materially exceeds engineers' estimates or comparable contracts without justification.

links.name: Purchase price far above comparable floor or last sale
links.ctx: A buyer pays a large premium for an item without supporting valuation.

links.name: Credits priced far below or above market with no quality basis
links.ctx: Offers significantly diverge from benchmark prices for the project type.

links.name: Price disproportionate to value
links.ctx: Price above or below a credible valuation.

links.name: Price materially above or below market
links.ctx: Declared price differs from valuation, followed by resale or loan at different value.

links.name: Transaction price materially different from market value
links.ctx: Transfer fees, sponsorship deals or image-rights payments are well above or below what comparable players, clubs or audiences would command.

links.name: Invoice price significantly differs from market value
links.ctx: Unit prices are well above or below the normal market range for the goods without a commercial rationale.

links.name: Price inconsistent with market or sudden value jumps
links.ctx: Sales at far off valuations or back-to-back trades.

links.name: Transaction price materially different from market value
links.ctx: Goods sold or bought between group companies at prices well above or below independent benchmarks.
